comments.mergedPostDetails:
The latest update has made it so that, by default, you cannot move at all with an action menu open.

Enabling one handed movement allows you to move forwards, but you cannot strafe, since the X axis now makes you rotate.

This is a regression; it should be possible to strafe while using an avatar menu. It is not possible to solve this by changing your controller bindings -- in the "one_hand" action set, the joystick position can only provide input to the "move_rotate" action. There isn't an option to use the "move" action.
comments.mergedPostTitle: It is no longer possible to strafe with an action menu open.

comments.value: Thank you for the report! A fix for this is in the works which will allow the hand not currently used by the action menu to keep the "Global" action set binds fully active. In other words if you had "move" on your left hand, when you open the action menu in your right hand, the left hand "move" will still work. If you had "rotate" on your right hand, when you open the action menu in your left hand, the "rotate" on your right hand will still work.
